profile_label: Book Forge Chinese A4 publication manuscript

publication_design_profile.page_geometry: A4 portrait; 1.25 inch side margins and 1 inch top/bottom margins for an editable manuscript companion and a PDF proof.
publication_design_profile.typography_hierarchy: Songti body with restrained black headings; PDF falls back to TeX-distributed Fandol when macOS typefaces are unavailable.
publication_design_profile.caption_style: Centered Chinese figure and table labels with compact spacing; captions stay with their objects.
publication_design_profile.figure_treatment: Centered figures constrained to the text width, with the figure label and image kept together where possible.
publication_design_profile.table_treatment: Booktabs tables constrained to the text width with column wrapping.
publication_design_profile.callout_style: Follow the book reader/style contract; no callout, case, or teaching-scene structure is added by this profile.
publication_design_profile.headers_footers: Centered Arabic page number in the footer.
publication_design_profile.page_numbering: Arabic page numbers in the center footer.
publication_design_profile.visual_rhythm: Continuous scholarly prose with readable leading, compact section spacing, centered figures, and booktabs tables.
publication_design_profile.rendered_page_inspection_plan: Inspect every rendered page of both formats, including title/byline/date, dense prose, figures, table wrapping and page breaks, references, page numbers, and the closing page.
